children.name: Euphronia hirtelloides
children.description: The native range of this species is SE. Colombia to N. Brazil. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Euphronia acuminatissima
children.description: A shrub or small tree of the family Euphroniaceae (order Malpighiales), described by Julian Steyermark in 1987. Its native range spans eastern Colombia to Venezuela (Amazonas), where it grows in the wet tropical biome; type-region collections are from savannas and riverine forest of the lower Rio Ventuari in the Venezuelan Guayana.

children.name: Euphronia guianensis
children.description: A shrub or tree of the family Euphroniaceae (order Malpighiales), accepted as Euphronia guianensis (basionym Lightia guianensis; combination by Hallier f., 1918). Native to the Guiana Shield from southeast Venezuela to western Guyana, it grows in the wet tropical biome. The genus was formerly placed in Vochysiaceae before Euphroniaceae was recognized.
